title: Client library API
what: The published bmo-testbed-client crate: every member, page, query and error code of the HTTP service as types, and behind its http feature the client calling each route, as docs/boundary.md states it.

title: Harness plugin API
what: The ahas-testbed MCP server and its eight tools, through which a harness runs a heavy command in the machine's queue and reads the queues, test runs and deployments, as docs/boundary.md states them.

title: HTTP service API
what: The read-only HTTP routes the serve verb puts over the record and the lanes: their members, pagination, error codes and event stream, as docs/boundary.md and docs/openapi.json state them.

title: Test support API
what: The dev-dependencies a consuming repository's tests take: the scratch-database crate, the test-support ids crate and the TypeScript test kit with its test home and stand-ins, as docs/boundary.md and docs/suite.md state them.

title: Command-line API
what: The bmo-testbed binary's command line: its verbs and flags, exit codes and JSON answers, the nouns bmo dispatches to it, and the checkout's own binary rule, as docs/boundary.md states them.
